settings.question: How often will I get updates or emails?
settings.answer: We're mindful of your inbox. Expect 1-2 thoughtful updates each month with new recipes, studies, and simple ways to keep your family protected.

settings.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
settings.answer: Yes, you have complete control. You can cancel or pause your membership at any time after a minimum of one-year subscription, no questions asked.

settings.question: What exactly will I get when I join?
settings.answer_list: Digital access to Susan's book|Fresh, mycotoxin-conscious recipes|Early looks at new research and practical science|Exclusive subscriber discounts|Plus new resources as we release them

settings.question: Is the digital book the full version?
settings.answer: Yes. Members get complete, unlimited access to read anywhere.

settings.question: Do you offer refunds?
settings.answer: Because you get immediate access to digital resources, subscriptions are non-refundable. But you can cancel anytime to avoid future renewals.

settings.question: Is this just for parents?
settings.answer: Not at all. While much of our work focuses on protecting children, anyone who wants to better understand hidden food toxins — and how to lower their risk — is welcome.
